product_metadata.title: Lipo Set of 2 18x18 Grey Throw Pillow Covers, Corduroy Decorative Square Pillowcases Corn Striped, Home Decor Decorations Cushion Case for Sofa Couch Bed, 18x18 Inch (Grey)
features: [Size and Package]: The package contains 2 pieces of 18x18 inches pillow covers. Pillow covers only, no pillow inserts.

[High-quality Soft Fabric]: Unlike most other products, our pillowcases use high-quality corduroy fabric. The appearance is comfortable, the hand feels elastic and soft, the velvet is clear and round, leaning on the pillowcase will make you feel relaxed.

[Small Invisible Zipper Design]: These pillow cases are sewn with invisible zippers on the edges, which are the same color as the pillowcases. They work smoothly and will not scratch your beautiful furniture.

[Wide application]: This super soft corduroy cushion pillow cover is suitable for living room, sofa, chair, bedroom, balcony, car, study, office, coffee shop, etc. It is also a great gift for friends, parents and relatives.
[Washing Tip]: Just throw your pillowcase into the washing machine, and then air dry gently. It will look as good as new!
